whyItMatters: A long quoted value assigned to an api_key-shaped variable may be a live credential with repository-wide readership. Generic shapes need human review, not blind trust.
actions: Determine whether the value is real: if yes, revoke it and move it to a secret manager.
If it is a placeholder, rename it to something obviously fake so future scans stay quiet.
Re-run a secrets scan to confirm the signal is resolved either way.
verification: The value is revoked-and-moved, or renamed to an obvious placeholder that no longer matches.
